title: Sharp embeddings between quasi-Banach Besov spaces and shallow ReLU variation spaces
summary: Let $\mathbb{D}$ be the ridge dictionary generated by $\operatorname{ReLU}^k$ on a bounded Lipschitz domain $Ω\subset\mathbb{R}^d$. We establish sharp embeddings between Besov spaces and the associated variation space $\mathcal L_1(\mathbb{D})$ in the quasi-Banach range $0 k+d/p$ for $1<q\le\infty$. A rescaled-bump construction shows that this smoothness threshold is sharp. Conversely, for $0<p<1$, \[ \mathcal L_1(\mathbb{D})\hookrightarrow B^{k+1}_{p,2}(Ω), \] and both the smoothness $k+1$ and the fine index $2$ are optimal.
